public_rationale: The records corroborate substantial losses, but the combined claim goes further by inferring a large pricing shortfall. OpenAI's contemporary figure was a forecast; Anthropic's later filing uses a different accounting basis. Neither establishes the size of the pricing shortfall at both companies. Company-wide losses also do not establish negative serving margins. The evidence therefore does not settle the combined proposition.
limitations: The unresolved outcome does not mean that either company was profitable.
The sentence's qualified pricing inference is less definite than its profitability assertion.
The available records mix forecasts, realized accounts, and different cost definitions.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic run unprofitable businesses and likely charge nowhere near enough to cover their costs.

statement.excerpt: Worse still, many of the companies integrating generative AI do so by connecting to models made by either OpenAI or Anthropic, both of whom are running unprofitable businesses, and likely charging nowhere near enough to cover their costs.

from_speaker: both of whom are running unprofitable businesses
likely charging nowhere near enough to cover their costs
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies 2024 as the relevant year. I assess the financial position described by the annual estimates available when the post appeared.
Unprofitable means that each company's revenue falls below its total expenses. It does not necessarily mean that serving an additional paying customer loses money.

The ordinary reading of the pricing clause is a substantial shortfall between current customer payments and the full costs of supplying the business's products. No numerical meaning is assigned to 'nowhere near'.
The pricing inference is qualified by 'likely'; it is not treated as an unconditional assertion of negative gross margins.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence establishes losses at both companies and a substantial shortfall between their customer payments and the relevant full costs, with enough detail to assess the pricing inference.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes profitability at either company, or establishes that their prevailing customer payments adequately cover the costs meant by the claim.
